 Man Killed in Collision on San Bernardino Freeway Near Via Verde 
 by Contributing Editor October 23, 2026 October 23, 2026 
 Share this:
 Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) 
 Facebook 
 Share on X (Opens in new window) 
 X 
 A 29-year-old man was killed in a multi-vehicle collision on the San Bernardino (10) Freeway between Covina and San Dimas before sunrise Friday.
 The multi-vehicle collision occurred at 3:29 a.m. Friday in eastbound lanes just west of Via Verde Street off-ramp, a California Highway Patrol officer told City News Service.

 First responders pronounced one person dead at the scene.
 He was later identified by the Los Angeles County Medical Examiner as Pedro Gavarrete.
 Information regarding what led up to the crash was not immediately released.
 The collision prompted a SigAlert shutting down the left four eastbound lanes.
 All lanes were cleared and the SigAlert was canceled at 8:23 a.m., the CHP reported.
